id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

lastMessage.description:
Last known message reported by the server regarding its status. As an example, in Kubernetes, this could output
the last known message from a pod's status for why it previously crashed.

debugPort.description: Debug port if this JVM is in debug mode

profilerPort.description: Profiler port if this JVM is running profiler agent

pid.description: POSIX process id of this server

latency.description: Latency of state update / heartbeat requests formatted as duration

startTime.description: Start time of JVM of this server

publicIpAddress.description: Public ip address if any associated

instanceStartTime.description: Start time of cloud compute instance of this server

lastHeartbeatTime.description: Time of the last state update / heartbeat request sent to this server by Leader

leader.description: Leader for this Server (aka C3 Cluster Node) if it is not a leader itself

name: Cluster.Worker
